Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
refactor(Grove): Standardize imports and format dev_log statements

Align the Grove codebase with project-wide style conventions by consolidating multi-line imports and reformating `dev_log!` macro invocations across the runtime, host, transport, and WASM subsystems.

- Unify `use` statements to group crate-relative imports (e.g., `crate::dev_log`) with local modules, removing redundant single-line imports scattered throughout the code.
- Reformat `dev_log!` calls to wrap arguments across multiple lines where necessary for readability, ensuring consistent indentation and brace placement in `Source/DevLog.rs`, `Source/Host/*`, `Source/Transport/*`, and `Source/WASM/*`.
- Add explicit Common library telemetry initialization in `Source/main.rs` to enable the dual-pipe PostHog/OTLP collector in debug builds.
- Update `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`, and `Cargo.toml` to reflect the completed migration and the addition of the Common dependency.

These changes improve code consistency and maintainability without altering functional behavior or API contracts.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
docs(Grove): Rewrite CHANGELOG with Keep a Changelog format and detailed commit history

Completely revise CHANGELOG.md to adopt Keep a Changelog conventions with expanded sections, commit SHAs, and dates. Key changes:

- Add descriptive header explaining Grove as the Rust/WASM extension-host sidecar
- Rewrite v2.1 section with full "Full Workbench Lift" details covering language-provider registration, provider-forwarding to Mountain, DevLog macro adoption, module PascalCase migration, and re-export cleanup
- Expand v2.0 to include all February-March 2026 buildout commits from scaffold to working host
- Consolidate v1.x and v0.0 placeholder commits into summary sections
- Add LAND_DEV_LOG → Trace rename to the Changed items

This gives future contributors clear visibility into what was built and why, with specific commit references for deep-diving.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
refactor(Grove): Remove re-exports and enforce module prefix usage

This change removes convenience re-exports from mod.rs files throughout Grove, forcing all consumers to use explicit module paths. Key updates:

- Remove pub use re-exports from API, Binary, Binary/Build, Common, Host, and WASM modules
- Update init_wasm_runtime() to return Runtime::WASMRuntime and use Runtime::WASMConfig::default()
- Update main.rs to use RuntimeBuild::RuntimeBuild and ServiceRegister::ServiceRegister fully qualified
- Add safety lints to main.rs: #![deny(unsafe_code)], #![warn(missing_docs)], #![warn(clippy::all)]
- Rename RuntimeBuildMod.rs→RuntimeBuild.rs and ServiceRegisterMod.rs→ServiceRegister.rs

This enforces consistent module access patterns and prevents E0255 conflicts from re-exported types.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
refactor(Grove): Replace tracing with custom DevLog tag-filtered logging system

Introduce a new DevLog module providing tag-filtered development logging controlled by the LAND_DEV_LOG environment variable. This replaces the tracing dependency throughout Grove.

Key changes:
- Add Source/DevLog.rs with tag-based logging (grove, wasm, transport, grpc, extensions, lifecycle, config, ipc, vfs, storage, commands, exthost, model, output, bootstrap)
- Support LAND_DEV_LOG=all, LAND_DEV_LOG=short for compressed output with path aliasing and deduplication
- Include OTLP span emission for Jaeger/OpenTelemetry integration
- Replace all tracing::info/debug/warn/error calls with dev_log! macro throughout the codebase
- Remove tracing_subscriber initialization from lib.rs and main.rs

This enables granular control over log verbosity per subsystem while maintaining the same logging interface across Mountain (Rust) and Wind/Sky (TypeScript).
